A Match the sentences and the responses.Write the letters a-e.Then practice with a partner.
1. French classes were my favorite.
a. It's no wonder that kids are overweight.
2. I walked two miles to school every day.
b. No wonder. It's the best time of year.
3. Lunch was always hot dogs and fries.
c. Me too. It's no wonder we were fit.
4. I couldn't wait for the summer.
d. No wonder. It's no fun if you're struggling.
5. I always fell behind in math. I hated it!
e. It's no wonder you're so fluent.
